lines.text: 2.2 Reasons fortow Groundwater in Pakistan
The water that is found underground in sand and rocks is termed as groundwater. It is stored
underground as aquifers. It supplies water for human consumption and agricultural uses.
Groundwater pumping fulfils these purposes and results in lowering of ground waterlevel. Many
areas of Pakistan are experiencing low groundwater table. It plays a pivotal role in mitigating
the impacts of less water availability through canal water supply and rainfall.
Themain reasons behind lowering of ground waterlevels are:
i. Increase in cultivated areas irrigated by groundwater: As the area under agriculture
increases, the demand for water also increases.As a result,farmers start using groundwaterfor
irrigation and its continuous use leads to lowering of theground watertable.
